metric: soybean grain yield difference, mean of 10 harvests
quote: Therefore, considering the results from the second soybean crop, mechanical management of soil compaction would not be the best option, since it can be substituted by cover crops, especially sunn hemp, which resulted in an average increase of 183 kg ha−1 in soy- bean yields in 10 seasons.
